paper.title: Secure Aggregation for Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning on Clinical EEG Data
paper.abstract: Federated learning enables multiple institutions to train shared models without exchanging raw clinical EEG data, but it does not fully prevent privacy leakage from individual model updates. This paper presents a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for clinical EEG data using masking-based secure aggregation as the core protection mechanism. The framework combines graph-based communication, threshold secret sharing, dropout-resilient aggregation, local update clipping, an optional Bloom filter-based privacy-preserving record-linkage initialization module, and auxiliary-notary-based verifiability. It supports both semi-honest and malicious aggregation settings and is implemented using the Flower federated learning framework. The secure-aggregation variants are evaluated in a simulated cross-silo healthcare setting using TUH EEG-derived data under different client configurations. Under the stated assumptions, the secure variants hide individual updates from the aggregation server. The results show that these variants remain compatible with federated model training, although malicious-setting safeguards and lightweight consistency-checking mechanisms introduce additional computation, communication, and round-duration overhead. The semi-honest variant provides the lowest overhead among the secure configurations, while malicious and auxiliary-notary variants offer stronger consistency, integrity, and lightweight verification support at higher cost.

paper.title: SmartGen: Seamless Disaggregated LLM Inference with Selective KV Cache Transfer
paper.abstract: Disaggregating the prefill and decoding stages of large language model (LLM) inference into two separate sets of nodes is widely adopted in today's LLM serving systems. However, such an architecture poses significant challenges for self-hosted LLM deployments on rented cloud instances, since transferring enormous key-value (KV) caches between disaggregated nodes can easily saturate the limited inter-node network bandwidth. In this paper, we propose to mitigate the network bottleneck by selectively transferring essential KV cache entries across the two stages. There are two challenges to achieve selective KV cache transfer, i.e., accurate KV selection during the prefill stage, and efficient KV fetching during the decoding stage. To address these challenges, we design SmartGen, a KV cache transfer engine that allows seamless disaggregated LLM inference with three data transfer paths. Specifically, we leverage 1) a profile-based proactive transfer path to identify and push essential KV cache entries to the decoding node during the prefill stage, 2) a parallel on-demand transfer path to simultaneously fetch remote and local KV cache entries during the decoding stage, and 3) a speculative transfer path to finally deliver all KV caches to the decoding node. Experimental results show that SmartGen reduces time-to-second-token by up to 4.3x compared with the typical full KV cache transfer approach while offering comparable subsequent decoding performance and accuracy.

The authors claim up to 4.3x reduction in time-to-second-token versus full-KV transfer with comparable decoding performance. (Title+abstract only)

paper.title: Queue-Theoretic Admission Control for Multi-Tenant GPU Clusters
paper.abstract: GPU cluster operators cannot predict how long pending workloads will wait for admission. Existing systems use greedy heuristics with no formal wait time guarantees. We formalize GPU cluster admission as a multi-class, multi-resource queueing network and prove a structural decomposition: the pending queue partitions into quotable workloads (bounded wait time under stability) and unfeasible workloads (no finite bound without reconfiguration). For quotable workloads, we model each cluster queue as an M/G/k system where the effective server count k is determined by a vector packing reduction; under an explicit stochastic domination assumption, we establish O(1/(1-rho)) wait time scaling. We prove that optimal admission ordering is NP-hard under multi-dimensional resource demands via reduction from vector bin packing. We validate on Kueue, the standard Kubernetes workload queuing system, using CPU, memory, and GPU (via Dynamic Resource Allocation) resources. The vector k_eff correctly identifies bottleneck resource dimensions, Little's Law holds exactly, and the Erlang-C approximation consistently overestimates observed wait times in the conservative direction.

They show optimal admission ordering is NP-hard via vector bin packing reduction. Validated on Kubernetes Kueue with CPU, memory, and GPU resources, demonstrating k_eff identifies bottlenecks and Erlang‑C provides conservative overestimates.

paper.title: FAIR-Compute: A Roadmap for Fair and Efficient Allocation of Federated Digital Research Infrastructure
paper.abstract: As demand for high-performance computing (HPC), high-throughput computing and data storage grows, the way scarce compute is allocated -- not just how much exists -- has become a decisive factor in the productivity of UK research. FAIR-Compute studies allocation in a federated Digital Research Infrastructure (DRI) as a problem at the intersection of algorithmic game theory, transport economics and HPC scheduling. Our central observation is simple: once a shared system must decide who runs, when and under what evidence, its scheduler settings cease to be a purely technical matter and become policy. The project combined three strands of evidence: a landscape review of UK and international allocation practice (including EuroHPC, WLCG, ACCESS, JASMIN and DiRAC) supported by a stakeholder survey; a mechanism-design model of allocation under strategic and uncertain user reports; and a simulation study built on the public Fresco/Anvil workload trace and controlled synthetic stress tests. Three results recur across all three strands. First, allocation records measure occupancy (resources reserved) rather than utilisation (useful work done), so the system cannot currently answer the question UKRI and DSIT most want answered -- whether resources deliver productive value. Second, simple, transparent scheduling heuristics perform close to an offline full-information benchmark once tuned, so the near-term opportunity is to tune and instrument existing schedulers rather than replace them. Third, federation is genuinely valuable but behaves like uncoordinated routing when left unmanaged: it can minimise average delay while quietly concentrating load -- and potentially harm -- on the receiving system. This mirrors a classic effect from road-traffic economics (Braess's paradox), where letting everyone independently pick the fastest route can leave the whole network worse off.

screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 与我的研究（网络感知运行时、调度、延迟/带宽敏感 MPC）直接相关，可为设计联邦调度策略、度量指标与仿真基准提供理论与实证参考。

What precise heuristics are simulated, and how robust are they across different workload mixes?
How do they quantify the practical gap between occupancy and utilization, and what instrumentation do they recommend?

paper.title: From Expert Reduction to Behavioral Divergence: Tracing Numerical State through Sparse MoE Inference
paper.abstract: Mathematically equivalent expert-reduction orders can produce observably different sparse-MoE executions. We isolate this effect in native DeepSeek-V4-Flash by freezing local MoE state and varying only aggregation semantics. Four schemes separate operand representation from accumulator precision. At one layer-5 fork, 720 A-mode orders yield 10 continuation basins; 720 B-mode orders form 360 exact structural classes and 11 basins. Under one Chinese prompt, the B classes split into 202 layoffs, 113 hiring, and 45 other continuations. Maximum-L-infinity B-branch selection separates 12, 24, and 36 of 50 prompts by 8, 16, and 32 tokens. Across 192 persistent trajectories per scheme, P32, A, and B change every native-reference route trajectory, while C preserves routes, token sequences, and texts. A separate 192-trajectory C check matches native MoE, post-mHC, next-router, and LM states bitwise. For one controlled B branch, exact post-mHC endpoint reconstruction reproduces the measured downstream trajectory. At the next decode boundary, exact FP64 reconstruction of the branch's full persistent state yields agreement for 301 downstream post-mHC states, 301 persistent-state checkpoints, 301 routes, predictions, and text over seven steps, given the same naturally generated next input. These controls identify post-mHC as an intra-token boundary and full persistent state as a cross-token continuation boundary. Identical tokens need not imply identical autoregressive state: divergence can survive a token boundary and become visible later. These results make expert operand conversion, accumulator precision, and reduction order part of a numerical compatibility contract for sparse-MoE runtimes and hardware backends. They establish controlled causal possibility, not deployment incidence; C's order invariance is limited to evaluated six-term states and schedules.

screening.short_summary_zh: 基于对稀疏Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 推理中数值与调度语义的实验，论文展示了相同专家规约（reduction）顺序可以导致可观测的推理分歧。通过冻结本地MoE状态并改变聚合语义，作者比较了多种运算表示与累加精度方案，识别出post-mHC为token内部边界、持久状态为跨token的连续边界，并强调操作数转换、累加器精度和规约顺序应成为稀疏-MoE运行时/硬件的数值兼容合约。
screening.short_summary_en: Empirically studies numerical and aggregation-order effects in sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference. By freezing local MoE state and varying aggregation semantics and operand/accumulator precisions, the authors show different reduction orders can cause observable divergences in downstream generations. They identify intra-token and cross-token boundary behaviors and argue operand conversion, accumulator precision and reduction order constitute a numerical compatibility contract for sparse-MoE runtimes/hardware.
screening.why_interesting_zh: 对安全/私有化LLM推理（如MPC或加密推理）高度相关：这些 settings 经常改变数值表述或精度，论文揭示了因数值表示或规约策略不同而导致的不兼容性风险，对设计可移植的私有推理运行时和协议选择有直接启发。
screening.why_interesting_en: Highly relevant to private LLM inference (e.g., MPC, quantized/encrypted inference): those contexts often change numeric representations/precision. The paper highlights concrete runtime/hardware-induced incompatibilities and gives guidance that is directly applicable when designing portable, numerically-compatible private inference stacks.
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 如果你的研究关注安全LLM推理、跨后端一致性、或运行时在不同精度/规约策略下的正确性，这篇论文应当认真阅读以理解数值兼容性风险与验证方法。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: If your work concerns secure LLM inference, cross-backend consistency, or runtime correctness under varied precision/reduction strategies, this paper is directly relevant for understanding numeric-compatibility risks and verification controls.
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 将论文中关于规约顺序、操作数转换与累加精度的检测/控制思路，纳入MPC/混合隐私推理运行时的兼容性测试套件；在协议切换或后端替换时增加数值一致性断言与回放检查。
screening.possible_transfer_en: Adapt their detection/control ideas for reduction order, operand conversion and accumulator precision into compatibility test suites for MPC/hybrid-private inference runtimes; add numeric-consistency assertions and replay checks when switching protocols or backends.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 与深度学习数值稳定性、量化与分布式聚合文献有关。作者声明是受控因果可能性而非普遍部署事件；需在全文核查实验设置、统计普遍性与对实际MPC后端的适用性。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: Relates to literature on numerical stability, quantization and distributed aggregation. The claims emphasize controlled causal possibility rather than deployment incidence—verify experimental setups, prevalence statistics, and applicability to real MPC backends.
questions_to_verify_zh: 实验是否在真实或典型的加密/MPC后端上复现？
不同规约顺序造成分歧的发生概率与典型触发场景是什么？
有没有给出可操作的对策（例如运行时断言、精度协议或回放检测工具）？
作者如何确保所观察的不一致不是由实现bug引起？
questions_to_verify_en: Are experiments reproduced on real/typical encrypted or MPC backends?
What is the incidence/probability and typical triggers for divergence under different reduction orders?
Do they provide actionable mitigations (runtime assertions, precision protocols, replay-check tools)?
How do authors rule out implementation bugs vs intrinsic numerical causes?

paper.title: Fully Inductive Cardinality Estimation
paper.abstract: Query optimization of Basic Graph Patterns (BGP) SPARQL queries over Knowledge Graphs (KG) requires accurate cardinality estimation. Recently published learned estimators outperform statistics- and sampling-based approaches, but share a limitation preventing their adoption in real-world triplestores: they are transductive and require retraining when the underlying graph changes or when applied to new graphs. We present FICE (Fully Inductive Cardinality Estimation), the first learned cardinality estimator for BGP queries over KGs that generalizes to entirely unseen graphs (including unseen relations), without any retraining. FICE is a graph neural network (GNN) with two coupled components. First, an encoder GNN over a factor-graph view of the KG produces entity and relation embeddings. We prove that BGP cardinality is a local function of the 2-hop neighborhood around bound terms in this view, motivating the local message-passing encoder. A decoder GNN then composes these embeddings along the join topology of the query to predict log-cardinality. The encoder and decoder are trained jointly, making the embeddings specialized for cardinality estimation. FICE is trained using neighborhood sampling to scale to KGs with millions of triples, and decouples embedding generation from cardinality decoding to enable estimation latency below a millisecond. Compared to learned and non-learned baselines over 10 KGs, FICE reduces the overall median q-error from 13.54 (for the best competitor) to 5.34 and dominates all approaches in tail behavior.

screening.short_summary_zh: 题目與摘要所述：FICE（Fully Inductive Cardinality Estimation）提出首个能对完全未见知识图（包括未见关系）进行泛化的 BGP 基本图模式基数估计器。方法为两个耦合的 GNN：基于因子图视角的局部编码器（证明基数为绑定项二跳邻域的局部函数），以及沿查询连接拓扑组合嵌入的解码器。通过邻域采样训练以扩展到百万级三元组并实现亚毫秒延迟估计。
screening.short_summary_en: Title/abstract-based summary: FICE is a learned cardinality estimator for SPARQL BGP queries that fully generalizes to unseen knowledge graphs (including unseen relations). It uses a factor-graph GNN encoder (local 2-hop neighborhood) and a decoder GNN along query join topology; trained with neighborhood sampling and claims sub-ms estimation latency and substantial q-error improvements over baselines.
screening.why_interesting_zh: 高度可迁移：准确的、可归纳到未见数据的基数估计对查询优化器、分布式查询调度与资源分配（包括私有查询执行的代价估计）非常重要。
screening.why_interesting_en: Highly transferable: an inductive, low-latency learned cardinality estimator could significantly impact query optimization, join ordering, and runtime scheduling in distributed DBs or systems that need fast cost estimates.
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 若你的方向涉及查询计划生成、依赖 DAG 调度或运行时成本建模（例如用于 MPC 查询分解或隐私查询调度），FICE 的 encoder/decoder 架构与局部性证明具有直接参考价值。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: Directly relevant if you work on query planning, DAG scheduling, or runtime cost modeling (e.g., for MPC query decomposition). Their locality result (2-hop suffices) and factor-graph encoding are particularly relevant.
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 将 FICE 的局部化 GNN 编码与快速解码器应用于：代价估计器、调度器的在线成本预测、critical-path 识别以及网络感知的分布式执行器决策中。
screening.possible_transfer_en: Apply FICE's local GNN encoder + join-topology decoder to build cost estimators for schedulers, online critical-path identification, and network-aware distributed execution planners.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 与其他学习型基数估计器在方法学上重叠，但其完全归纳性（无重训练）是区分点。需注意与现有 DBMS 优化器接口的集成问题。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: Overlaps with learned cardinality estimators, but claims of full inductive generalization set it apart. Integration with existing optimizer APIs may be nontrivial.
questions_to_verify_zh: 作者如何证明或验证 2-hop 局部性在各种 KG 模式（稠密/稀疏、不同模式）下成立？
在实际数据库/三元组存储中，生成嵌入与解码的端到端延迟与内存开销是多少（尤其是“亚毫秒”估计的前提）？
对未见关系的泛化能力在跨域（领域转移）场景上有多稳健？
questions_to_verify_en: How do the authors validate the 2-hop locality claim across different KG regimes (dense/sparse, schema variations)?
What are the end-to-end latency and memory costs for embedding generation and decoding in real triplestores, supporting the sub-ms claim?
How robust is generalization to unseen relations across cross-domain transfers?

paper.title: Piggybacking on Perception: Stealthy Concurrent Audio Prompt Injections against Multimodal LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-driven multimodal agents are increasingly deployed to execute autonomous tasks via continuous audio interaction. While this paradigm enhances interaction naturalness, it introduces a critical yet under-explored attack surface, as audio inputs inevitably contain environmental noise beyond user control. In this paper, we investigate concurrent audio prompt injection attacks targeting multimodal agents. Distinct from traditional acoustic attacks on voice devices, we propose novel techniques for instruction augmentation and scenario concealment. These methods allow malicious audio instructions to imperceptibly "piggyback" onto user speech, thereby hijacking agents to execute malicious actions. To systematically quantify this threat, we construct AudioAgentSecurity, the first comprehensive benchmark for audio instruction injection attacks, encompassing 8 real-world task scenarios and 10 distinct attack patterns. We evaluate 11 state-of-the-art agents, including Gemini 3 Pro and GPT-4o-audio. Notably, our methods achieve an average Attack Success Rate (ASR) of 69.10\% against the advanced Gemini 3 Pro. To counter this threat, we further introduce Cascaded Audio Decoupling and Verification (CADV), a defense mechanism based on source separation and consistency analysis. Compared with existing prompt-level defenses, CADV leverages acoustic source separation and cross-modal consistency analysis to detect audio instruction injections more robustly, achieving over 90\% detection success across diverse attack vectors. Finally, real-world experiments with human volunteers on Doubao AI Smartphone in diverse dynamic real-world scenarios confirm the attacks' high stealth and efficacy, while demonstrating that our defense reliably mitigates these vulnerabilities.

screening.short_summary_zh: 基于题目与摘要：本文研究针对多模态（含音频）大模型代理的并发音频提示注入攻击，提出“指令增强”和“情景掩盖”等新技术，使恶意音频能在用户语音上隐蔽地“搭载”指令。构建了AudioAgentSecurity基准（8场景、10种攻击模式），在11个先进代理上评测并报告高成功率；并提出基于声源分离与跨模态一致性分析的CADV防御，声称能在多种攻击下实现较高检测率；并在真实手机与志愿者上做了实验验证。注意：以上基于标题与摘要。
screening.short_summary_en: Title-and-abstract-based: The paper studies concurrent audio prompt-injection attacks against multimodal LLM agents, proposing novel instruction-augmentation and scenario-concealment techniques that let malicious audio 'piggyback' on user speech. They build AudioAgentSecurity (8 scenarios, 10 attack types), evaluate 11 agents (e.g., Gemini 3 Pro), report high attack success rates, and propose CADV — a defense using source separation and cross-modal consistency — with reported high detection. Real-world volunteer experiments on a smartphone are summarized in the abstract. Analysis limited to title/abstract.
screening.why_interesting_zh: 对关注“安全的LLM推理/隐私保护ML”的研究者有价值：攻击模型与防御侧同时呈现，数据集与真实设备实验对实系统威胁建模有直接启发。摘要提到的声源分离＋一致性检测思路可能可借鉴到安全LLM推理的输入验证层。说明：基于题目/摘要分析。
screening.why_interesting_en: Relevant to secure LLM inference and privacy-preserving ML: the paper presents both novel attack patterns and a defense pipeline that operates at the audio/acoustic layer. The use of source separation plus cross-modal consistency checks could inform input-validation layers for secure LLM inference systems. Note: claims are title-and-abstract-based.
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 若你在做安全的LLM推理或隐私保护推断（尤其含语音输入），此工作直接相关：攻击建模、benchmark设计与防御架构都可参考；若主攻MPC编译/运行时，则可借鉴输入验证与跨模态一致性作为外部监测层，与MPC协议的安全边界相互配合。基于摘要。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: If your work targets secure LLM inference or privacy-preserving inference with audio, this is directly relevant: attack models, benchmark, and defense pipeline are applicable. For MPC compiler/runtime work, the proposed input-validation (source separation & consistency) could be integrated as an out-of-band monitor to complement MPC security boundaries. Analysis title-and-abstract-based.
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 声源分离与跨模态一致性检测可迁移为MPC系统之外的输入过滤/审计模块（低开销在线检测），也可用于部署含秘密输入的模型推理前的可疑输入筛查。基于摘要。
screening.possible_transfer_en: Source separation and cross-modal consistency checks could be adapted as out-of-band input-filtering/auditing modules for MPC-based inference, enabling low-latency online detection of suspicious audio before invoking secure computation. (Title/abstract-based.)
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 与MPC本身的加密协议无直接冲突，但在系统整合层可能存在重复功能（若你的部署已包含严格传感器信任链与验证流程）。需要评估CADV与现有信任/认证机制的重复或互补性。基于摘要。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: No direct conflict with MPC protocols, but overlap may occur at the system integration layer if your deployment already uses sensor attestation or input verification. Evaluate whether CADV is complementary or redundant with existing mechanisms. (Title/abstract-based.)
questions_to_verify_zh: CADV在真实部署上（移动设备、实时流）带来的时延和计算开销是多少？
声源分离模块是否需要模型/训练数据，白盒／黑盒适应性如何？
评估中各代理的测试条件（麦克风、SNR、环境噪声分布）是什么？
报告的90%检测率在不同攻击强度、掩盖率和语境下是否稳定？
攻击构造是否依赖于模型输出接口或需要可听但不被人察觉的频谱变化？
questions_to_verify_en: What are CADV’s latency and compute overheads in real-time/mobile deployments?
Does the source-separation module require training data or per-device calibration; how does it generalize?
What were the exact evaluation conditions for the 11 agents (microphone, SNR, environments)?
Is the claimed >90% detection stable across attack strengths, concealment levels, and scenarios?
Do the attacks rely on access to model outputs/interfaces or exploit only the acoustic channel; what are the perceptual/energy trade-offs?

paper.title: It's All Just Vectorization: einx, a Universal Notation for Tensor Operations
paper.abstract: Tensor operations represent a cornerstone of modern scientific computing. However, the Numpy-like notation adopted by predominant tensor frameworks is often difficult to read and write and prone to so-called shape errors, i.a., due to following inconsistent rules across a large, complex collection of operations. Alternatives like einsum and einops have gained popularity, but are inherently restricted to few operations and lack the generality required for a universal model of tensor programming. To derive a better paradigm, we revisit vectorization as a function for transforming tensor operations, and use it to both lift lower-order operations to higher-order operations, and conceptually decompose higher-order operations to lower-order operations and their vectorization. Building on the universal nature of vectorization, we introduce einx, a universal notation for tensor operations. It uses declarative, pointful expressions that are defined by analogy with loop notation and represent the vectorization of tensor operations. The notation reduces the large APIs of existing frameworks to a small set of elementary operations, applies consistent rules across all operations, and enables a clean, readable and writable representation in code. We provide an implementation of einx that is embedded in Python and integrates seamlessly with existing tensor frameworks: https://github.com/fferflo/einx

screening.short_summary_zh: 基于标题与摘要：作者将向量化（vectorization）视为统一的张量操作范式，提出 einx——一种基于点式（pointful）、类循环记法的通用张量操作表示。einx 用少数基本操作和一致规则替代大型 API，并宣称可嵌入 Python 与现有张量框架（摘要中给出源码链接）。目标是提高可读性并减少 shape 错误。
screening.short_summary_en: Based on title and abstract: the authors reinterpret vectorization as a universal tensor-operation paradigm and propose einx — a pointful, loop-analogy notation that represents vectorized tensor operations. einx aims to reduce large framework APIs to a small set of elementary ops, enforce consistent rules across operations, improve readability, and integrates with Python and existing tensor frameworks (repo link provided in abstract).
screening.why_interesting_zh: 对 MPC/隐私计算中常见的张量密集型隐私推理（例如基于 MPC 的模型推理与加密张量代数），更简洁且可组合的张量表示与变换规则可能简化编译器前端、提高批处理/合并通信的可能性，从而影响协议选择与运行时调度。
screening.why_interesting_en: For MPC / privacy-preserving computation that runs tensor-heavy workloads, a concise, uniform tensor notation and systematic vectorization could simplify compiler frontends, enable more aggressive batching/round-coalescing, and make dependency-aware scheduling / protocol selection easier to reason about.
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 标题与摘要层面来看，einx 可能为 MPC 编译器（例如将高阶算子拆为低阶算子并重写为批量化形式）提供语义与变换规则，利于生成更少轮次或更高效通信模式的中间表示。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: At the title/abstract level, einx could provide semantics/transformation rules for MPC compilers (e.g., decomposing high-order ops into lower-order ops plus vectorization) that help produce IRs amenable to batching, round merging, or protocol-specific lowering.
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 可借鉴的点包括：统一的向量化变换用于自动将逐样/逐轴运算合并为批量化操作、减少通信轮次的重写规则、以及为运行时生成依赖信息以启发批次/管道调度。
screening.possible_transfer_en: Potential transfers: using the universal vectorization transformations to automatically merge per-sample/axis ops into batched ops, rewrite rules that reduce communication rounds, and producing dependency-rich IRs that guide batching/pipeline scheduling in MPC runtimes.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 无直接冲突（基于摘要）。若已有 MPC 框架已有约定的 IR/优化通道，集成可能需要适配层或对等的变换语义映射。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: No direct conflict (based on abstract). Integration with existing MPC IRs/optimizers may require an adaptation layer or semantic mapping between einx transformations and current lowering passes.
questions_to_verify_zh: 摘要中声明的实现细节（接口示例、落地到 JAX/NumPy/PyTorch 的具体流程）有哪些？能否查看代码和示例？
einx 的重写规则是否包含显式的通信/并行意识（例如为分布式/加密场景标记要合并的维度或批次）？
是否有性能/可读性的定量对比（例如与 einsum/einops、现有框架 IR 在编译与运行时的差异）？
questions_to_verify_en: What are the exact implementation details and examples for the claimed integration with JAX/NumPy/PyTorch? Is the repo runnable and documented?
Do einx rewrite/vectorization rules include explicit communication/parallelism annotations or guidance useful for distributed or encrypted execution (e.g., which axes to batch/merge)?
Are there quantitative comparisons (readability metrics aside) showing runtime or communication improvements versus einsum/einops or existing IRs when lowered for real workloads?
